whatToWatch.text: Seattle's pass rush is the headliner: 2.7 sacks per game to Kansas City's 1.6, and with Chiefs tackle Josh Simmons listed out, the Lumen crowd could turn third down into chaos.
Low-scoring alarm bells — the total sits at 42.5 for a reason. Seattle's giving up 20.3 a game, KC just 16.6, so every red zone trip and every field goal could swing this one.

A 3-3 team on a two-game slide is still favored by 3 at home, and that's the honest stakes: win and the season steadies, lose and it's three straight. Seattle's down three with two more questionable (Chazz Surratt, Drake Thomas, Anthony Bradford); KC is without Rashee Rice.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle's backfield arrives at Lumen Field held together with tape: Jadarian Price remains parked on injured reserve, leaving Zach Charbonnet's availability as the week's biggest question mark against Kansas City. Mike Macdonald offered nothing on Charbonnet's progress, so the Seahawks may have to manufacture a run game against the Chiefs with whoever's standing. Few storylines carry more weight Sunday than who lines up behind center in the backfield.
